summary:
Earth’s surface is constantly changing, but understanding where, how, and why these transformations occur remains a major challenge.

TerraWatch is an intelligent geospatial platform that transforms satellite radar observations into meaningful visual insights. By leveraging NASA-ISRO NISAR mission data and Geographic Information Systems (GIS), it provides an interactive environment to investigate, characterize, and visualize potential changes in Earth’s surface, with a focus on seismic-related transformations.

More than a visualization tool, TerraWatch bridges advanced satellite remote sensing and accessible geospatial exploration, helping users interpret complex Earth observation data and better understand environmental changes.

Our vision is to turn satellite intelligence into actionable geospatial knowledge, making Earth’s transformations easier to observe, explore, and understand.
details:
TerraWatch is an intelligent geospatial platform designed to transform satellite radar observations into accessible information for monitoring and understanding changes on Earth’s surface.

The platform integrates Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) remote sensing data with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to support the identification, visualization, and interpretation of potential surface transformations. By leveraging the NASA-ISRO NISAR mission’s radar observation capabilities, TerraWatch addresses the challenge of making complex Earth observation data more understandable and useful.

The platform is organized into two main sections. The Project section presents the scientific background, data sources, and methodology through an interactive StoryMap. The Explore section provides an interactive mapping environment where users can navigate the study area and examine available geospatial datasets and analytical layers.

TerraWatch is developed using the ArcGIS ecosystem, particularly ArcGIS StoryMaps and ArcGIS Experience Builder, to connect scientific communication with interactive geospatial exploration. Satellite data processing and analysis are supported by remote sensing and GIS workflows.

Its main innovation lies in bringing satellite-based Earth observation and interactive geospatial communication together in a single platform. Rather than presenting isolated maps or complex datasets, TerraWatch aims to make spatial information easier to explore, interpret, and communicate.

The team considered data availability, scientific reliability, spatial accuracy, visualization, accessibility, and the limitations of satellite observations throughout the development process.

Ultimately, TerraWatch aims to demonstrate how satellite intelligence and geospatial technology can support a better understanding of Earth’s changing surface and contribute to informed environmental monitoring and disaster risk assessment.
